item.title: SUNshine Girl Carmen
item.description: SUNshine Girl Carmen likes shopping, adventure, and experiencing new things. The 5-foot beauty enjoys trying new foods and loves to travel. This Disney fan says she wants to move to California so she can be closer to a warm, sunny beach. She posed for us in January 2020. (Ernest Doroszuk/Toronto Sun)
